summary: First iteration backend testing of ConceptForge. All 17 pytest tests passed in 57.75s covering: auth (register/login/me/logout, cookie+bearer, duplicate, wrong password), concept generation (full pipeline returns roadmap with milestones+video_queries, study_guide markdown, image as data URL or null, videos list with embed URLs), list/get/delete concepts, tutor chat (post + history persistence), and cross-user access control (User B gets 404 for User A's concept on GET/DELETE/chat). Admin seed verified. Concept generation for 'Python lists' beginner took ~25-35s and produced all required fields including a non-null image and >=1 youtube video.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 449 lines — acceptable now but split into modules (auth, concepts, chat, ai_services) before it grows further.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to FastAPI lifespan context manager.
set_auth_cookie uses secure=False — fine for dev/preview over HTTP-emulated ingress, but switch to secure=True in production.
CORS allow_origins falls back to '*' while allow_credentials=True; browsers will reject credentialed requests with wildcard. Set explicit origins in production .env.
No brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook recommends lockout after 5 fails) — not blocking but a security gap.
Concept generation runs roadmap sequentially then guide/image/videos in parallel; could parallelize study guide with roadmap by deriving image_prompt/queries lazily — minor latency optimization.
list_concepts caps at 200 with no pagination params; acceptable for MVP.
test_credentials: admin@conceptforge.app / admin123 (seeded); per-run unique test_a_<id>@ and test_b_<id>@ registered fresh each run
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run registers two ephemeral users (test_a_<runid>@, test_b_<runid>@). The created concept is deleted at end of test; chat_messages for it are cascaded by the DELETE handler. Ephemeral users remain in DB but are unique per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_conceptforge.py covers all endpoints listed in the review request. If retesting after changes, the suite is idempotent (unique per-run emails). Concept generate endpoint timeout is set to 120s — keep that buffer for AI calls. For frontend testing in a future iteration, use admin@conceptforge.app/admin123 or register a new user.
